nodes.label: ROLLER
nodes.rationale: PVC and aluminum profile manufacturer; site goals are informational acquaintance of clients and the public; 20 years on market; slogan Тепло и комфорт для каждого дома / Гармию осоиш ба хар як хонадон.

nodes.label: OOO Alumini Avvalin
nodes.rationale: Opened in 2025 based on long PVC-industry experience; modern production of aluminum profile systems.

nodes.label: IMZO-inspired visual style
nodes.rationale: Desired look similar to competitor IMZO, but must not fully copy; client open to inventing something better together.

nodes.label: Product catalog
nodes.rationale: Full catalog with categories and product cards, without prices; only price-by-calculation.

nodes.label: Price by calculation
nodes.rationale: No exact or from-prices on site; pricing shown only as calculated quote.

nodes.label: Cost calculator
nodes.rationale: Simple calculation form (not full calculator); for windows and doors; leads to WhatsApp +992 700 600 700.

nodes.label: Warmth and comfort for every home
nodes.norm_label: warmth and comfort for every home

nodes.label: ROLLER PVC warranty terms
nodes.rationale: 15 years on PVC window/door profiles (lightfastness, integrity, manufacturing defects); colored profiles 10 years in one note; excludes hardware, glazing units, and assembly/install errors.

nodes.label: Next.js breaking-changes agent rule
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes vs training data; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code and heed deprecation notices.
